review_notes: Inspected all 109 lines of TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/ContinuousFamily.lean, plus the imported source file TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/SmallPerturbation.lean (used at line 60), the index API in TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/Module/ContinuousLinearMap/Index.lean, the related whole-file pattern TauCeti/Topology/LocallyConstant/Preconnected.lean, the in-repo consumer TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/CompactPerturbation.lean:137-147, and the Mathlib declarations actually cited by the rewrites (Mathlib/Topology/Path.lean:60-103, Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/PathConnected.lean:34-48, Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/AffineSpace/AffineMap.lean:487-529). Simp-interface assessment: the file contains no `@[simp]` attributes (its conclusions are conditional implications between the indices of two different operators, e.g. `index T = index S`, so there is no canonical normal form to rewrite to and marking any of them `[simp]` would be an arbitrary, potentially non-terminating orientation; cf. the discipline documented in TauCeti/Analysis/Fredholm/LevelSet/Basic.lean:459-460). There are only two simplification steps: line 85 `simpa only [A.source, A.target]` rewrites `A 0`/`A 1` to `T`/`S` using Mathlib's `Path.source`/`Path.target`, which are themselves `@[simp, grind =]` lemmas (Path.lean:97-103) in the same orientation, so no competing rule or expansion is introduced; and line 103 `simpa only [Path.segment_apply, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module]` rewrites `Path.segment T S t` to `lineMap T S ↑t` and then to `(1 - ↑t) • T + ↑t • S`, which is literally the hypothesis shape at lines 97-98, so the direction matches the statement and the `lineMap_apply_module` RHS (AffineMap.lean:500-501). `Path.segment_apply` is a `@[simps]`-generated simp lemma whose RHS is `lineMap` (PathConnected.lean:35-37), so the file does not add an unwanted expansion of `Path.segment`; the endpoints of a segment are already covered by Mathlib's `@[simp]` `lineMap_apply_zero`/`lineMap_apply_one` (AffineMap.lean:524-529), so no missing simp lemma for a degenerate segment is apparent. Remaining uncertainty: I could not run Lean, so I did not verify simp-set behaviour empirically; also, whether a pointwise `@[simp]` bridge such as `index (A 0) = index (A 1)` for a `Path` would be useful downstream cannot be established from the sources read (the only in-repo consumer, CompactPerturbation.lean:147, uses `simpa using ... 1 0`, not such a bridge), so I do not claim it as a justified finding.
